description: This file provides utilities for managing launch agents and processes on macOS, including executing 'launchctl' commands, parsing launch agent property lists, and extracting specific configurations and environment variables.

classes.name: LaunchAgentPlistSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of a launch agent's property list configuration, including program arguments, environment variables, output paths, and network settings.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously executes the 'launchctl' command with arguments and returns a Result object containing the status and output.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Reads and parses a launch agent plist file at a given URL, extracting configuration details into a LaunchAgentPlistSnapshot object.
